headline: Claude-assisted hack of OpenAI staff accounts nudges catastrophic risk
body: A quiet day. A three-person white-hat team used Claude Opus 5 to chain bugs from an OpenAI forum upload into logged-in access to employee accounts, a reminder of AI-boosted hacking that raises Catastrophic Risk and nudges Self-Destruction. Anthropic giving Faculty employee-level access for independent evaluations was a small plus for Alignment & Control. Horizon Balance edged to -3.75.
movers_note: Zookeeper -0.1, from fading earlier news (-0.07) and Faculty's evaluation access (-0.05). Conquerors -0.1, from Faculty's evaluation access (-0.07) and fading earlier news (-0.07), partly offset by the Hacktron hack (+0.04). Self-Destruction +0.1, from the Hacktron hack (+0.16), partly offset by Faculty's evaluation access (-0.04) and smaller items (-0.03).
